in_sanskrit.name: Anjeet
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Graceful, Pleasing
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anjeet एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anjeet is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anj’ which means ‘graceful, pleasing’. In Hindu mythology, Anjeet is the name of a divine being who bestows grace and blessings upon his devotees.
